input.prompt: A single seamless tileable orthographic material texture: tobacco-brown vegetable-tanned leather, one square covering exactly 0.30 metre across. Fine small-scale pebble grain, restrained subtle natural wear, warm brown tonal variation and an even matte appearance. Uniform diffuse base colour (albedo) only, delighted flat full-frame swatch. Match both opposite edge pairs seamlessly, top/bottom and left/right, with no discontinuity when repeated in a grid. No stitching, no seams, no embossed designs, no logos, no text, no strong scars, no folds, no perspective, no directional lighting, no reflections or highlights, no baked shadows or ambient occlusion, no vignette, no border or exposure gradient. One square tile covering the full image; suitable for final 512x512 texture.
